steps.code:
# Fetch all unique songs and count artists
from collections import defaultdict

artist_counts = defaultdict(int)
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=access_token, song_id=sid)
    for artist in song['artists']:
        artist_counts[artist['name']] += 1

# Get top 3 artists
top_artists = sorted(artist_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:3]
print(top_artists)
